name: keibidrop
description: Give two agents on two machines the same folder. Peer to peer, encrypted end to end, no cloud storage in between.
long_description: KeibiDrop connects two machines directly and gives each one access to a folder on the other. Traffic is encrypted end to end with a hybrid post-quantum key exchange, and a relay is used only to help the two peers find each other, holding an encrypted blob it cannot read. With a FUSE provider present the peer's files are ordinary paths, so a program reads them where they sit and only the bytes it reads cross the network, which suits model weights and datasets. Pairing needs a code from each side, so a single leaked code connects nobody. Sending is limited to one directory named at startup.
